question: Where is the Kailasa temple built by Rashtrakutas located?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ellora**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Kailasa Temple, built by the** Rashtrakutas**, is located in Ellora, Maharashtra, India.
 
• It is one of the most remarkable rock-cut temples in the world and is **dedicated to Lord Shiva.**
 
• The temple complex, which includes 34 monasteries and temples, is a **UNESCO World Heritage Site**.
 
• The Kailasa Temple, **also known as Kailasanatha Temple**, is famous for its **monolithic structure**, carved from a single rock.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Hampi, a UNESCO World Heritage Site **located in Karnataka, India.
 
• Hampi was the capital of the **Vijayanagara Empire** from the 14th to the 16th century.
 
• The site is famous for its **Dravidian architecture** and includes over 1,600 ancient monuments, temples, and structures.
 
• **Kanchipuram (Kanchi)**, is a city in Tamil Nadu, India, known for its rich history, cultural significance, and beautiful temples.
 
• It served as a capital for various South Indian dynasties, including the **Pallavas, Cholas, and Vijayanagara Empire**.
 
• The **Amravati Stupa** is one of the largest stupas in India and is renowned for its intricately carved stone.
 
• Amravati has been designated as the new capital city of the state of Andhra Pradesh, **established after the bifurcation of the state in 2014.**
